title: Fix Profile Setup overlay by implementing backend user profile methods and wiring React Query hooks

requirements.text: Implement Motoko backend support for caller user profiles by adding public shared methods `getCallerUserProfile()` and `saveCallerUserProfile(...)` in `backend/main.mo`, storing profiles in the existing `userProfiles` map keyed by caller Principal, and returning the created/updated profile.

quotes: Profile save method not yet implemented in backend. Please add getCallerUserProfile() and saveCallerUserProfile() methods to backend/main.mo

acceptanceCriteria: Calling `getCallerUserProfile()` as an authenticated user returns null/none when no profile exists for the caller.

Calling `saveCallerUserProfile(...)` creates a new profile for the caller when none exists, with `id = caller`, `createdAt` set on first create, `lastLogin` set/updated on save, and `testAttempts` initialized to an empty array.
Calling `saveCallerUserProfile(...)` for an existing caller updates the profile fields and updates `lastLogin` without resetting `createdAt` or overwriting `testAttempts`.
The canister Candid includes both methods and the frontend actor can call them without trapping with "Method not implemented".

requirements.text: Wire the frontend React Query hooks to the real backend profile methods: update `useGetCallerUserProfile` and `useSaveCallerUserProfile` in `frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts` to call the backend methods, keep the existing query key `['currentUserProfile']`, and ensure the query is invalidated/refetched on successful save so the Profile Setup dialog is dismissed by `App.tsx` logic.
acceptanceCriteria: `useGetCallerUserProfile` calls the backend `getCallerUserProfile()` and returns a `UserProfile` when present, otherwise `null`.
`useSaveCallerUserProfile` calls backend `saveCallerUserProfile(...)` and no longer throws the hardcoded "Profile save method not yet implemented" error.
After a successful profile save, `['currentUserProfile']` is invalidated and refetched, and `App.tsx` stops rendering `<ProfileSetup />` (overlay disappears and the app becomes usable).
On save failure, the Profile Setup dialog remains open and a user-visible error toast is shown (in English).

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in `backend/main.mo` (no additional backend services).
Do not edit any files under `frontend/src/components/ui` or any paths listed as immutable in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.
Use English for any user-facing text.
nonGoals: Implementing other stubbed backend methods (tests, questions, comments, suggestions, admin panel) beyond what is required to fix profile creation/fetch.
Adding third-party authentication providers (only Internet Identity is supported).
Changing the overall landing page/dashboard feature set beyond ensuring the profile overlay can be dismissed.
